lines.text: Every product we build from here will need to know things.
Today, each one carries its own copy and its own wording. Ten products mean ten versions of the truth.
Verity treats knowledge like a utility. You plug in. You don't rebuild it.
Legal approves a sentence once, and every channel is told: the phone, the chat, the advocate's screen, and products nobody has built yet.
The rules travel with it: who may see it, whether it is current, who signed it off.
The advocate stops guessing, and the member hears the same answer everywhere.
So, how long does mail order take?
Seven to ten business days. On the phone, in chat, and on the advocate's screen. One approved unit, cited every time.
Verity is the layer underneath. Built once, and everything we build next stands on it.
Verity. One approved truth, in every channel.
